capabilities: Look up and insert Google Calendar events into the editor
Look up and insert Google Contacts and Workspace Directory info
disambiguation: It does not sync calendars or manage contacts; it only looks up data and inserts it into the active note.
extras: Detailed usage is deferred to external plugin documentation; the README covers only features and that the commands appear when an editor is active.
problem: Obsidian has no way to pull in calendar events or contact information, so meeting notes and CRM-style contact notes must be filled in by hand.
summary: Google lookup plugin that inserts Calendar events and contact details into the current note via editor commands.
